features: Complete Apple Music SF Pro & SF Pro Display typography with tabular figures across all screens, sheets, and players
Dynamic Island in-app notifications & marquee ticker for likes, playlists, queue actions, sleep timers, and auth updates
Redesigned Apple Music Search experience with browse categories, Top Result glass card, live suggestions, and filter chips
Redesigned Welcome, Email OTP & 4-step Onboarding flows with spatial aurora backdrop and Apple spring motion

Room Together Phase 1 & 2 overhaul with persistent v1 rooms, LiveKit voice audio, synced karaoke lyrics, moments, song requests, reactions, themes, QR/WhatsApp deep links, achievements, insights & shareable PNG recaps
fixes: Restored Search back navigation (onBack) and prioritized live suggestions while typing
Fixed InnerTube YouTube.kt automix null-safety crashes and added multi-tier SmartQueueEngine radio fallback
Eliminated GoogleFonts/Inter fallback across album, artist, login, insights, settings, and Dynamic Island notifications
Hardened R8/ProGuard keep rules for WebRTC & LiveKit voice media in release APKs
improvements: Removed google_fonts dependency completely for faster cold start, offline font rendering, and native SF Pro fidelity
Upgraded ShellScreen scroll-driven dock morphing and canonical ZenPlayButton / ZenShuffleButton / ZenActionCircle controls
Replaced legacy APK bundles with fresh v1.0.8 (Build 12) ARM64 & Universal release packages across web, API, and GitHub Releases
releaseNotes:
• Complete Apple Music SF Pro typography & removal of google_fonts
• Dynamic Island in-app notifications across likes, queue, timers & settings
• Redesigned Apple Music Search, Login, Email OTP & Onboarding with spring motion
• Room Together Phase 1 & 2 overhaul with LiveKit voice, synced lyrics, moments, requests, themes & PNG recaps
• Search back-navigation, InnerTube automix, smart queue & R8 LiveKit release build hardening (v1.0.8 Build 12)
message: Update to v1.0.8 (Build 12) for Apple Music Search, Auth & Onboarding redesigns, Dynamic Island notifications, SF Pro typography, and Room Together Phase 1 & 2 upgrades
